fact: The Auditor-General's 2024 audit says Korle Klottey Municipal Assembly acquired from BlueDot Business Solutions, as Software as a Service, the Revenue Management and Administration Platform System (RMAPS) for property rates billing and collection, which began under the government's myassembly.gov initiative for all MMDAs, was suspended over implementation challenges and is available to interested assemblies.
title: Performance Audit Report of the Auditor-General on Computerised Financial and Electronic Systems in Selected Covered Entities as at 31 December 2024
